events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, began in Bethel, New York, on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off, becoming more than just a festival – it was a cultural phenomenon. What's your favourite memory or track from the era?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at his Graceland home at the age of 42 on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us 49 years ago today. His music and legend live on. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away at the age of 25 in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, six days after a shooting incident.

angles.name: Tupac's Influence
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, we lost a true icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose powerful lyrics and impact on hip-hop continue to resonate. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away in London at the age of 27 on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi's Guitar Genius
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, the world lost a musical revolutionary. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose unparalleled guitar skills changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring its legendary zebra crossing cover, in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous in history. What's your favourite track from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce stage presence with The Pretenders have defined decades of rock. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or Liam solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us the powerful album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant today as ever. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: iPod launch anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod, revolutionising how people listened to music on the go, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple launched the original iPod. It put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. Did you have one of the early models?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, a global celebration of the iconic film franchise, commemorating the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, 007 has given us so many iconic moments. Who's your favourite Bond and what's your top Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder and solo artist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His songwriting and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at his home in London at the age of 45 on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true showman. Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
